description: Ulpianus connects ChatGPT to the Chilean legal corpus: case law from all instances (Supreme Court, Courts of Appeals and trial courts), current statutes and legal doctrine. It answers your legal questions by quoting the rulings verbatim, showing the court that issued each decision and a link to the original text (juris.pjud.cl, Ley Chile) so you can verify every citation yourself. Find a ruling by its exact case number or research a topic in natural language. Built for lawyers, paralegals and law students in Chile. Your queries are not used to train models.
